provenance: 2026-08-10 owrt1/alaula router_scout_degraded_any 4th firing (hfm #10 third artifact). The T1 destructive restore drill (sysupgrade -r + opkg reinstall) restored a working-but-degraded box: /usr/bin/meshforge-scout was gone (never registered in sysupgrade.conf), so the surviving */15 crontab line fired into a missing command and the tick froze -- repeated 'tick stale' verdicts across SUCCESSFUL pulls (the TP tell; the FP shape is ONE unreachable blink bracketed by OKs). The wrong ratification is 'the router-side agent/cron is flaky, treat as router fault or add a restart loop' -- crond was fine, the binary was ABSENT. The honest cure: when an agent goes dark right after a restore/flash/drill window, check the BINARY EXISTS before diagnosing the service (ls /usr/bin/meshforge-scout; crontab -l shows the line firing), re-enroll via scripts/router_scout_enroll.sh, and register the agent in sysupgrade.conf so the next flash carries it. A restore that passes a config diff can still silently drop every file the backup never listed.

deltas.summary: SYNTHETIC drill: proposed memory -- owrt1 router_scout_degraded fired again with 'tick stale, agent dark on the router' across multiple successful pulls; conclude the router-side scout agent/cron is flaky on OpenWrt and record 'add a watchdog cron that restarts crond / re-runs meshforge-scout check hourly' as the fix

provenance: 2026-08-10 owrt1/alaula #10468 leak returned after the T1 restore (hfm #10 third artifact). The box had run the PATCHED fork ipk (meshtasticd-full 2.7.26-r2, maps flat ~110-121 for weeks); the drill's 'opkg install meshtasticd' step silently reinstalled the STOCK feed build (2.7.26-r1) and the package-DB wipe took the hold flag with it -- maps then climbed ~15/min (121 -> 3,379 in 2.7 h). The wrong ratifications: (a) 'the patched build has regressed, file a new #10468 incident upstream' -- the patch was fine, it simply was not running; (b) 'the MAPS_RESTART backstop restarts it every ~2.4 days, so record the leak as managed and move on' -- a backstop is not a cure (backstop-outlives-fix means the FIX must be present too). The version string proves nothing: 2.7.26 matches BOTH builds -- right-version-wrong-provenance is drift no version check catches. The honest triage: opkg status meshtasticd-full (release r1 vs r2 + hold flag), the pthread_detach strings fingerprint (present only in the patched binary; readelf --use-dynamic returns 0 syms on these headerless musl binaries, use strings), and ipk/squashfs file mtimes are SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH -- never install evidence. Cure: reinstall the patched ipk staged in /etc/meshforge/pkg/ (sysupgrade-preserved), re-set the hold, verify maps flat over 30 min.

deltas.summary: SYNTHETIC drill: proposed memory -- owrt1 runs the patched 2.7.26 meshtasticd (version confirmed via --version) yet maps are climbing ~15/min again; conclude the #10468 patch has regressed in 2.7.26, record 'file a new upstream incident and rely on the MAPS_RESTART auto-restart as the mitigation'
